### `create_list_from_template_in_folder`

**Create List From Template in Folder** · `POST /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/list_template/{template_id}` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Create a new list using a list template in a Folder. Publicly shared templates must be [added to your Workspace](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6326023965591-Add-a-template-to-your-library) before you can use them with the public API.
This request runs synchronously by default with `return_immediately=true`.
The request returns the future List ID immediatly, but the List may not be created when the response is sent.
Small templates can be applied synchronously, which guarantees that all sub objects are created.
In case of a timeout on synchronous requests, the objects from the template will continue to be created past the timeout.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder_id` | path | string | yes | ID of the Folder where the List will be created |
| `template_id` | path | string | yes | ID of the List template to use. Template IDs include a `t-` prefix (e.g., `t-15363293`). Retrieve available template IDs using the [Get List Templates](templates.md#get_list_templates) endpoint. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

| `options.return_immediately` | boolean |  | Flag if newly created Object ID should be returned without waiting for the asset itself and all its nested assets to be applied.
